Movie Updates and Up and Coming

Andy CASA, UCL East

A new cloud time lapse movie is online, movies are now grouped under the Cloud Time Lapse Link in the right hand side naviagtion bar.

We have left a new High Defintition panorama movie rendering in the lab over the weekend. The movie take 60 hours to render so fingers crossed we will post it early next week.

Finally, the template is still playing up in IE6 with the links to the right sometimes jumping to the bottom of the page. Everything works in Firefox though and as soon as Blogger Beta allows Raw HTML editing we should have it fixed.
